newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia cuts top market rate to 7.81 from 8.81 pct [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Tunisia cuts top market rate to 7.81 from 8.81 pct [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT].

text.p: (Corrects old rate in headline to 8.81 pct from 8.1 pct, makes conform to text).
Tunisia cut its average money market rate to 7.81 percent from 8.81 percent on Tuesday, in line with last week's announcement to this effect, bankers said on Wednesday.

Announcing the cut last week, Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali said it was taken "considering the progress that has been made in containing inflation, and in the aim of providing eased conditions for financing and credit so as to stimulate investment and revitalize Tunisian businesses."
Tunisia forecasts an inflation rate of less than 4.5 percent this year after 6.2 percent in 1995.
